verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents standard IMAP/SMTP access to its inboxes, including from clients like Thunderbird. That is its own open-protocol route for pulling messages out, and custom domains mean your addresses are not tied to the vendor. However, there is no documented bulk-export feature, export format, account-deletion, or migration/offboarding guidance. missing for 10: a dedicated full-data export (messages, threads, labels, lists, attachments, configuration) in documented open formats, documented offboarding/account deletion, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: AgentMail supports standard IMAP and SMTP protocols, allowing you to connect using traditional email clients or integrate with existing systems that rely on these protocols.
Connect Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, or any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client to your AgentMail inbox
